Class AlertBroadcastManagerImpl

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.alerting.manager.AlertBroadcastManagerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
AlertBroadcastManager
public class AlertBroadcastManagerImpl extends Object implements AlertBroadcastManager
Translates the public AlertBroadcastManager API into calls on TWO internal service classes: it pushes the live event via AlertBroadcastService AND records it in the recipient's inbox via NotificationInboxService. This is the "manager spans more than one internal class" case the professor called out.
